name: What kind of data does AI use for website optimization?

mainEntity.name: What kind of data does AI use for website optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI leverages a wide range of data for website optimization, including user search queries, click-through rates, bounce rates, dwell time, conversion data, competitor analysis, backlink profiles, and technical website performance metrics. It also analyzes semantic relationships within content, trending topics, and algorithm updates to make informed decisions and predictive recommendations for improving search visibility and user experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI uses search queries, user behavior, conversion data, competitor analysis, technical metrics, and content semantics to optimize websites.
